intuition: A hash map locates entries while a doubly linked list keeps most- and least-recently used entries in order.

brute_force.approach: Store key-value pairs in a list and scan or move entries when they are accessed.

optimal.approach: Combine a dictionary with a doubly linked list and sentinels so lookups, promotion, and eviction are constant time.

edge_cases: Updating an existing key also makes it most recently used.
Capacity one evicts the previous entry on every new key.
